grammar.topic: Gerund and infinitive: enjoy -ing, decide to
explainTr: Bazı fiillerden sonra ikinci fiil -ing alır: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, practice, keep, imagine. Örnek: I enjoy working here. Would you mind closing the door?
Bazı fiillerden sonra 'to + fiil' gelir: decide, hope, plan, manage, refuse, promise, want, need. Örnek: I decided to apply. She hopes to get the job. Prefer ve like gibi fiiller ikisini de alır.
Edattan sonra her zaman -ing gelir: She is good at talking with parents. Hangi fiilin hangi kalıbı aldığı ezberlenir; bu yüzden fiilleri örnek cümleyle öğren.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'çalışmayı severim' ve 'çalışmak istiyorum' farklı ekler alır ama kural fiile bağlı değildir. İngilizcede kalıbı fiil belirler: enjoy working ama want to work.

reading.title: What does Hafsa enjoy at work?
reading.text:
After two weeks at Lincoln Elementary, Hafsa knows what she enjoys and what she wants to avoid. She enjoys helping children read. She loves watching a child's face when a hard word finally makes sense. She also enjoys working with the other staff, and she doesn't mind staying late to prepare materials.

But some things are difficult. She avoids speaking in front of the whole school because her English is still not perfect. Yesterday the principal asked her to read the morning announcements, so she decided to practice at home first. She kept reading the text aloud for half an hour. Emre listened and said, "Mom, you sound great!" She knows that practice is the best way to improve, so she keeps looking for small chances to use her English every day.

This morning she managed to read the announcements without a single mistake. Afterward, Mr. Brown suggested joining the staff meeting on Friday. Hafsa hesitated for a moment, and then she promised to come. "I hope to learn something new every day," she told him.

On the way home, she imagined working at the school full-time. She is not sure yet, but she plans to apply for a permanent position in the spring. Learning a language is slow, and sometimes it feels hard, but she refuses to give up.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: Hafsa, do you enjoy working here?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Very much. I enjoy talking with the children, and I love helping them learn new words.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: That's great. Do you mind working with the younger students? Some people avoid teaching first grade.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I don't mind at all. Actually, I prefer working with younger children.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: Good. Mr. Brown wants to know if you can start on Monday.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Monday? That's soon, but I think I can manage it.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: He suggested giving you the second-grade class for the first week.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Wonderful. I promise to arrive early every day.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: Don't forget to bring your ID. And keep smiling. The kids love that.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I will. I've decided to stay here as long as possible.

writing.promptTr: Mr. Brown'a kısa bir teşekkür e-postası yaz: neyden keyif alıyorsun, neden kaçınıyorsun, ne yapmayı planlıyorsun? (80-120 kelime)
writing.promptEn: Write a short thank-you email to Mr. Brown. Say what you enjoy, what you avoid and what you plan to do. (80-120 words)
writing.model: Dear Mr. Brown, Thank you for the opportunity to work at your school. I enjoy helping children read, and I really like working with the other staff. I don't mind staying after school to prepare lessons. I avoid speaking too fast because my English is still not perfect. I have decided to practice every evening. I hope to become a full-time teacher one day, and I plan to take an online class this winter. I promise to work hard. Thank you again for your support. Sincerely, Hafsa
